ident: # TEMPLATE GUIDE: Radio Navigation Aids (VOR
name: DME

ident: # ident: 2 or 3-letter ICAO radio navigation aid code (e.g. LAM
name: CPT

ident: # name: Facility / Station name (string)
# country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. GB
name: DE

ident: # latitude: WGS84 decimal degrees (-90.0 to 90.0)
# longitude: WGS84 decimal degrees (-180.0 to 180.0)
# type: 'VOR-DME'
name: 'DME'

ident: # service_category: 'ENROUTE' (Long-range airways) or 'TMA' (Terminal Maneuvering Area / Airport approach)
# power: 'HIGH' (High-power enroute transmitter) or 'LOW' (Low-power terminal area transmitter)
# elevation_ft: Reported site elevation above mean sea level in feet (optional
name: will be validated against EU-DEM)

ident: # frequency_khz: Radio carrier frequency in kHz (e.g. 115600 for 115.60 MHz VHF)
# dme_channel: UHF paired DME channel code (e.g. 103X
name: 40X)

ident: # range_nm: Designated Operational Coverage (DOC) range in nautical miles:
#           - LOW Power / TMA: 25.0 to 40.0 NM (airport terminal area only)
#           - HIGH Power / ENROUTE: 130.0 NM (en-route airway navigation)
# elevation_min_deg: Antenna lower vertical beam cutoff angle (default: 30.0 degrees for DME 30-150 degree window
name: 0.5 degrees for VOR)

ident: # elevation_max_deg: Antenna upper vertical beam cutoff angle (default: 150.0 degrees for DME 120-degree vertical slice
name: 60.0 degrees for VOR cone)

ident: # Examples:
LAM
name: Lambourne

ident: CPT
name: Compton

ident: KLO
name: Kloten

ident: GVA
name: Geneve Cointrin

ident: NAT
name: Nantes Atlantique

ident: PSA
name: Pisa San Giusto
